name: R-18: a stranger can build and boot the desktop from the README on a fresh machine
command: fresh VM osr18b (150G overlay off golden; no node/npm/cargo/gcc/psql preinstalled) running guest-r18.sh: clone b98518640b8d, README steps apt-prereqs, toolchains, npm ci, lint-tsc, ui-build, desktop-ci, desktop-dev
summary: Every README step exited 0 on a machine with no toolchain. npm run lint:tsc reported LINT_TSC_RESULT exit=0 status=clean head=b98518640b. The desktop booted with its own embedded Postgres on :5532. The operator served /api/health {ok:true, sha:b9851864} on :3270 and the SPA root returned 200 (38793 bytes). The X window 'Papercusp' (1278x775) was on screen. Screenshot sha256 e9e24b05a8bc07f1f6a7979ab914f6e65e632323b7d13d4ea21289a722c4acc4.

assertions.evidence: ~/r18/steps.log: apt-prereqs .. desktop-ci all 'END ... rc=0'; desktop-dev LAUNCHED pid 13703 at 06:02:18Z.
LINT_TSC_RESULT label=operator-core scope=all exit=0 status=clean head=b98518640b
xwininfo: 0xa00003 "Papercusp" 1278x775; the screenshot is a 1280x800 PNG.
